name: Eran Orr
title: Founder, CEO
bio: With over seven years of experience in the healthcare technology industry, Eran is the CEO and founder of XRHealth, the first VR/AR/MR telehealth platform in the world. He holds an MBA in Entrepreneurship and Innovation and a BA in Business Management, Government, and Politics, as well as a certification in Human Subjects Research – Biomedical (Biomed) Comprehensive. Eran founded XRHealth after undergoing long rehabilitation processes and believing that VR/AR/MR technology will transform healthcare as we know it. He leads a team of experts in developing immersive, therapeutic applications that address a wide range of neuro-cognitive, emotional, and physical symptoms. These applications are combined with an advanced data portal that utilizes AI and cloud computing to deliver meaningful data analytics for monitoring and managing patients remotely. The platform also enables live, two-way interactions between patients and their healthcare providers. Eran's mission is to enable healthcare providers to precisely adapt treatments to individual patient needs in a fun and engaging way and improve their quality of life. Eran is also a co-founder and chairman of the board of Envoya Inc., a company that develop biopolymers nano particles for gene therapy. He has multiple patents and honors in the field of healthcare tech.
